chunks: And Allah has made for you from that which He created shade, and has made for you in the mountains shelters, and has made for you garments to protect you from the heat, and garments to protect you from your war, thus He perfects His favor upon you so that you may be grateful.

key_terms.تَسْلُمُونَ: You may be grateful or submit

ai.seo_question: What are the specific blessings of shade, shelter, and clothing mentioned in Surah An-Nahl?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted through the lens of divine grace (ni'mah) extending from natural provisions like shade and mountains to the spiritual 'garments' of taqwa (God-consciousness) that protect against the turmoil of worldly life. The term 'sarabil' (garments) is seen as a metaphor for both physical protection and the inner covering of faith, culminating in the purpose of 'Islam'—complete submission to the Divine Will. This highlights the holistic nature of Allah's blessings, linking material comfort with spiritual orientation.
